title: SCORE: Subject Coordinate Recovery for Label-Free Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.19134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate visual decoding can reveal how the brain represents visual information and recover perceived content from neural signals such as electroencephalography (EEG), with potential for neural communication. However, current EEG-to-image retrieval methods perform far below their within-subject counterparts for new users without labeled calibration, limiting real-world deployment. To understand this gap, we analyze EEG features across subjects and find that different subjects preserve similar relationships among concepts but express them along different coordinate directions. We therefore propose Subject Coordinate Recovery (SCORE), a target label-free framework combining recovery-aware source training with coordinate alignment at deployment. translated_title: SCORE：面向无标签跨受试者脑电-图像检索的受试者坐标恢复
translated_abstract: 摘要：精确的视觉解码可以揭示大脑如何表征视觉信息，并从脑电图（EEG）等神经信号中恢复感知内容，有望用于神经通信。然而，当前的脑电-图像检索方法在新用户没有标注校准的情况下，其性能远低于受试者内部的对应方法，限制了实际部署。为理解这一差距，我们分析了跨受试者的脑电特征，发现不同受试者保持了概念间的相似关系，但沿不同坐标方向表达。因此，我们提出受试者坐标恢复（SCORE），一种目标无标签框架，结合恢复感知的源训练与部署时的坐标对齐。训练期间，SCORE将源受试者脑电与公共图像空间对齐，并通过仅源情节模拟未见受试者的恢复。部署时，在两个编码器冻结的情况下，SCORE选择...
tldr: SCORE提出一种无标签跨受试者脑电-图像检索方法，通过恢复感知训练和坐标对齐，解决新用户特征坐标偏移问题，提升检索性能。
en_tdlr: SCORE proposes a label-free cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval method that uses recovery-aware training and coordinate alignment to address feature coordinate shifts in new users, improving retrieval performance.
